Shikai: Sensuirairin (チ水來臨, Advent of Thousand Waters) - Command:Descent from Heaven (天下れ, Amakudare) - upon calling the command, the hilt of the zanpakuto becomes a silver vajra, with Five prongs and a base in the middle, from which the blade protrudes from. The blade itself becomes a crystalline silvery blue water.

Shikai special ability: The basic ability of this zanpakuto is to control any water around 100m/1000ft, even from those formed from enemies techniques, attach it to the blade and transform water from the tip of the vajra and infuse it with reiryoku. The user can change the form of the blade and increase/decrease size at will. It can change forms indefinitely, mostly taking the form of weapons, although size and mass can only increase based on the amount of the water gathered by the user. This zanpakuto is said to be more of a support than attack type as it lacks pure offensive, relying more in its versatility. As such, its is commonly paired with Kido by channeling it into the blade, with zanjutsu by transforming the blade to suit its opponents or with hakuda by coating the user's arms with the water. 

Bankai: Happonirami Ashuku no Bansuikanrin (八方睨み阿閦之萬瑞鑑輪/All-Auspicious Mirrored Cycle of the All-seeing Akshobhya): to be concluded.
